summary: Talos Energy Inc. filed an 8-K announcing that its subsidiary, Talos Production Inc., priced an $800M offering of 8.000% second-priority senior secured notes due 2034. The net proceeds will fund a portion of the cash consideration for a previously announced Gulf of America acquisition. Additionally, a conditional notice of redemption was issued for all outstanding 9.000% second-priority senior secured notes due 2029, redeemable at 104.500% of principal plus accrued interest, contingent on the closing of the offering. This is a debt financing transaction and redemption, not a change-of-control event. The filing does not disclose the acquisition terms or target. Watch for closing of the offering and the related acquisition.
